codex_project_prompt.purpose: Multi-agent AI drug repurposing, drug combination, molecular validation and safety research platform
codex_project_prompt.tagline: Discover potential drug combinations. Validate molecular evidence. Explain scientific possibilities.

project_vision.objective: Build an evidence-driven research platform connecting drug repurposing, experimental drug-combination analysis, molecular validation, interaction screening and Gemma 4 explanations.
project_vision.capability: Identify existing drugs that may merit investigation for a disease.
Validate chemical structures and calculate molecular properties.
Retrieve known drug-drug interaction warnings where accessible.
Explain evidence, uncertainty and research hypotheses.

agent.responsibility: Integrate ChEMBL for drug-target and bioactivity information.
Integrate PubChem for chemical identifiers, SMILES and molecular properties.
Integrate DrugComb for experimental combination evidence and synergy measurements.
Integrate PubMed for published research.
Integrate DrugBank only where authorised access is available for interaction information.
Integrate DGIdb for drug-gene relationships and ZINC for screening compounds.
Verify API access, licensing, authentication, rate limits and data provenance.
Never fabricate API results.
Accept a disease query and retrieve disease-associated genes and targets.
Retrieve drugs associated with those targets and analyse known mechanisms.
Retrieve pathway and publication evidence.
Rank candidates using transparent dimensions: biological relevance, drug-target evidence, experimental evidence, preclinical evidence, clinical evidence and data completeness.
Do not treat target associations or docking scores as proof of therapeutic efficacy.
Resolve and standardise drug identities before analysis.
Retrieve experimental combination records, synergy metrics, cell lines and experimental conditions.
Interpret ZIP, Bliss, Loewe and HSA only when source data supports them.
Check known DDI warnings, toxicity, pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic interactions where evidence is available.
Track experimental concentrations and ratios; never assume a universal 1:1 ratio.
Distinguish GO, REVIEW and NO-GO as computational workflow decisions only.
If safety evidence is unavailable, return UNKNOWN or REVIEW rather than Low risk.
Never provide patient-specific doses or treatment recommendations.
Use RDKit to parse and validate SMILES, SDF and MOL structures.
Calculate molecular weight, LogP, H-bond donors and acceptors, TPSA and rotatable bonds.
Implement Lipinski screening and available structural-alert checks.
Distinguish measured ADMET data from computational predictions.
Treat fragment reconstruction as optional and only create chemically valid, explicitly justified structures.
Never identify a known drug from fragment resemblance alone.
Treat AutoDock Vina docking as an optional extension and docking scores as estimates, not proof of activity.
Integrate Gemma 4 through a configurable local or remote inference provider.
Use GEMMA_MODEL, GEMMA_BASE_URL and GEMMA_API_KEY environment variables.
Generate evidence-grounded explanations for repurposing, combinations, interactions, molecular properties and research hypotheses.
Use structured JSON outputs and schema validation.
Preserve citations and explicitly report missing or conflicting evidence.
Never invent drug interactions, SMILES, properties, synergy scores or citations.
Do not expose private chain-of-thought; provide concise auditable evidence summaries.
Build a responsive Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind dashboard.
Create Dashboard, Drug Repurposing, Drug Combination Analysis, Molecular Analysis, Drug Safety, Knowledge Graph, Evidence Explorer and AI Assistant pages.
Show real backend data, evidence provenance, warnings, experimental ratios and synergy context.
Use charts and graph visualisations where useful.
Do not display fabricated statistics or unsupported medical claims.

orchestrator.instruction: Inspect the repository before changing files.
Create AGENTS.md, skills.md and the reusable Agent Skill before implementation.
Assign clear file ownership and prevent conflicting edits.
Delegate independent tasks and integrate their outputs.
If multi-agent delegation is unavailable, execute workstreams sequentially without claiming agents were spawned.
Run tests and verify the complete workflow.
Do not overwrite user files without inspecting them.
Do not claim tests or integrations succeeded unless actually verified.

constraint.name: dangerous_drug_interactions
constraint.rule: Two individually safe medicines may produce harmful effects when combined.
Interactions may increase toxicity or reduce effectiveness.
Check known DDI sources and metabolic or pharmacodynamic warnings where supported.
Absence of a database warning does not establish safety.
Unavailable interaction evidence must be classified UNKNOWN or REVIEW.

constraint.name: effectiveness_is_difficult_to_predict
constraint.rule: A theoretical biological mechanism does not prove clinical effectiveness.
Separate computational, docking, in-vitro, animal and human clinical evidence.

constraint.name: incomplete_or_conflicting_combination_evidence
constraint.rule: Not every drug combination has been studied.
Some results may be contradictory or context-dependent.
Show missing evidence and conflicting findings; do not infer that missing means ineffective.

constraint.name: drug_quantity_and_ratio
constraint.rule: Concentration and ratio can change combination outcomes.
Retrieve experimental concentrations, units, dose ranges and ratios when available.
Compare only compatible experimental contexts.
Never present experimental ratios as clinical dosing recommendations.

constraint.name: data_availability
constraint.rule: Some pharmaceutical databases restrict API access.
Use public APIs where possible, respect licensing and provide transparent fallbacks.

constraint.name: data_accuracy
constraint.rule: Research may be outdated, incomplete or contradictory.
Record dates, preserve source identifiers, deduplicate and prioritise traceable research.

constraint.name: drug_identification
constraint.rule: Medicines may have similar names, synonyms, salt forms or formulations.
Resolve using standard identifiers such as ChEMBL ID, PubChem CID and DrugBank ID where available.
Check active ingredients, stereochemistry and canonical SMILES where available.

constraint.name: additional_constraints
constraint.rule: Gemma hallucinations and outdated knowledge.
Limited computing resources and API rate limits.
Missing protein structures and invalid molecular reconstructions.
Incompatible synergy metrics and cell-line differences.
Incomplete toxicity information and lack of wet-lab validation.
Database licensing and reproducibility limitations.

signature_feature.name: Repurposing-to-Combination Intelligence Engine
signature_feature.scientific_caveat: Complementary biological targets do not prove synergy or clinical benefit.

molecular_validation.rule: Never invent missing chemical properties. RDKit parse success does not mean a molecule is safe.

api_output_contract.rule: Unknown evidence remains UNKNOWN; missing values remain null; latency must be measured; no fabricated reasoning traces or citations.

technical_architecture.visualisation: Recharts and React Flow or equivalent

reusable_agent_skill.name: drug-discovery
reusable_agent_skill.description: Build evidence-grounded drug repurposing, drug combination, molecular validation and biomedical research workflows using Gemma 4.
reusable_agent_skill.topic: Biomedical data retrieval and identifier standardisation
SMILES validation and molecular property calculation
Synergy metric and experimental ratio interpretation
Grounded Gemma prompts and scientific claim validation

testing_requirements.test_case: Test valid and invalid chemical structures.
Test identifier resolution and formulation distinctions.
Test RDKit property calculations and null handling.
Test drug-target retrieval and candidate ranking.
Test metric interpretation and experimental context.
Test dose and ratio handling without clinical dosing claims.
Test known warnings and unavailable interaction evidence.
Show separate findings across cell lines and contradictory studies.
Reject unsupported or chemically invalid reconstruction.
Test external API failure and fallback behaviour.

final_deliverables.deliverable: Implementation report with verified integrations, test results and limitations

execution_instructions.step: Create AGENTS.md, skills.md and reusable SKILL.md.
Establish architecture and delegate tasks to six agents.
Build backend and frontend in parallel where possible.
Implement molecular validation and safety screening.
Run tests and fix integration errors.
If a service is unavailable, use a transparent, clearly labelled fallback.
Do not stop after writing a plan; implement the working MVP.
Do not claim tests or integrations succeeded unless verified.

success_criteria.criterion: User can enter a disease and retrieve potential repurposing candidates.
User can inspect biological targets and evidence.
User can select two drugs and investigate experimental combinations.
User can compare available synergy metrics and experimental ratios.
User can validate molecular structures using RDKit.
User can review known interaction warnings and missing safety evidence.
User can inspect conflicting evidence and source citations.
User can request an evidence-grounded Gemma 4 explanation.
User can generate a research report.
